content.short: Birdeye is a professional crypto trading data aggregator providing real-time analytics, price charts, and deep liquidity insights for DeFi.
content.description: Birdeye is a comprehensive data analytics platform that offers real-time insights into token performance, trading volume, and liquidity across multiple chains. By indexing the Mantle Network, Birdeye provides traders and developers with sophisticated charting tools and on-chain metrics for the entire Mantle ecosystem. Its platform helps users identify market trends and monitor asset movements with high precision, making it an indispensable tool for participants in the Mantle DeFi landscape.
content.meta: Birdeye provides real-time crypto trading data and analytics for the Mantle Network. Discover Birdeye on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
